title: Stage inverse-image sheaf colimit on the affine site
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps. Let $c$ be a limit cone and fix $i_0$ and a sheaf of sets $G$ on $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison]. On the full affine étale site [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site] of $D(i_0)$, set $A_j=(f_j)_*f_j^{-1}G$ and $L=p_*p^{-1}G$, restricted to that site, where $f_j=D(j\to i_0)$ and $p=c.\pi_{i_0}$. Any diagram $E$ and cocone $K$ with objects $A_j$, point $L$, and maps and legs equal componentwise to the canonical section comparisons is a colimit cocone in sheaves of sets. This assertion is at sheaf level and does not assert that evaluation preserves the colimit.

source.place: Tag 09YQ, proof via Sites Tags 09YN and 0A35

proof.text: Form the presheaf colimit Q of the underlying stage diagram. Its comparison a to the underlying limit sheaf is locally injective and locally surjective by the two local comparison statements. These are separate equality and existence claims, and neither claims the colimit universal property.

Sheafify the presheaf colimit cocone to obtain a colimiting sheaf cocone H (Mathlib Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone). Its universal property gives q : H.pt → K.pt. Compare coprojections using Sheaf.sheafifyCocone_ι_app_val and the factorization equations of H: the presheaf comparison is toSheafify(Q) followed by q.hom. The presheaf colimit hom-ext theorem proves this equality.

The sheafification unit is locally surjective. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac and Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac transfer the two local properties of a to q.hom. Apply Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso to q, and IsColimit.ofPointIso to the colimiting cocone H. This proves Nonempty(IsColimit K) with its given objects and component equations unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A35, equality/existence split; formal sheafification assembly using Mathlib Sites/Limits and LocallyBijective
